bibl.title: Spatially Distributed Local Fields in the Hippocampus Encode Rat Position

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: The hippocampal local field potential in freely moving rats, and whether the animal's position can be read out of it.
span.quote: In the hippocampus, neurons discharge selectively when the rat is at certain locations, while LFPs at single anatomical sites exhibit no such place-tuning.

span.label: If no single electrode's field potential is tuned to place, can position nevertheless be recovered from many electrodes at once?
span.quote: Nonetheless, because the representation of position is sparse and distributed, we hypothesized that spatial information can be recovered from multiple-site LFP recordings.

span.label: Shows the spatiotemporal structure of the theta rhythm encodes position about as well as spiking populations do, and introduces feature-tuned field potentials as the LFP counterpart of place cells.
span.quote: Using high-density sampling of LFP and computational methods, we show that the spatiotemporal structure of the theta rhythm can encode position as robustly as neuronal spiking populations.

span.label: existence
span.quote: We demonstrated that the rat’s location is encoded by spatial variations of the hippocampal LFP.

span.label: spatial position coding in hippocampal local field potentials
span.quote: In the hippocampus, neurons discharge selectively when the rat is at certain locations, while LFPs at single anatomical sites exhibit no such place-tuning.

span.label: electrophysiology
span.quote: Rats were implanted with 32-, 64-, or 256-site silicon probes in the hippocampus to monitor both LFP and unit firing ( Fig. 1A ) while they traversed a linear track ( Fig. 1B ), open field, or a T maze ( 11 ).

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Because hippocampal place cells are not topographically arranged, any one electrode pools dissimilarly tuned neurons and therefore shows only weak place modulation, which is why the code appears only across many sites
span.quote: In contrast, because place cells in the hippocampus are distributed without topographic ordering ( 23 ), the LFP measured at any single location exhibits only weak place-modulation ( fig. S9 ).

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: During movement the population is driven by a single sparse cause - current position - so unsupervised source separation can recover that cause from mixed, subsampled field-potential measurements
span.quote: During movement, population activity in the hippocampus is largely determined by a single (i.e., highly sparse) cause: the rat’s current position.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The theta LFP inherits position information because it is generated mainly by the membrane potential fluctuations of the place cell population itself
span.quote: We hypothesized that the theta rhythm also contains information about the rat’s position, since it is primarily the place cell population whose membrane potential fluctuations give rise to the LFP ( 10 ).

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the theta rhythm is treated as a radio carrier wave, and position is recovered by demodulating it - stripping the carrier phase to leave a spatial pattern
span.quote: The demodulation operation then removed the phase of the theta carrier from each electrode, resulting in a spatiotemporal pattern of relative phase and amplitude that covaried smoothly ( Fig. 1, E and F ) with the rat’s position.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: the LFP carries place information because it is generated by the membrane potentials of the place-cell population itself
span.quote: We hypothesized that the theta rhythm also contains information about the rat’s position, since it is primarily the place cell population whose membrane potential fluctuations give rise to the LFP ( 10 ).

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: position is a single sparse cause driving the whole population, which is why an unsupervised method can recover it without being told where the rat is
span.quote: During movement, population activity in the hippocampus is largely determined by a single (i.e., highly sparse) cause: the rat’s current position.

span.label: The unsupervised (ICA) discovery of position-tuned field-potential features degrades as trial-by-trial neuronal variability grows: fewer components are recovered from noisy populations.
span.note: what this limits: the number of position-tuned components recovered: AS THE TRIAL-BY-TRIAL VARIABILITY OF NEURONAL ACTIVITY WAS INCREASED, ICA IDENTIFIED A DECREASING NUMBER OF FFPs
span.quote: However, as the trial-by-trial variability of neuronal activity was increased, ICA identified a decreasing number of FFPs.

span.label: Each electrode pools a large, non-topographically-ordered population, so any single site is only weakly place-modulated.
span.note: what this limits: any single-site interpretation of the field potential: EACH ELECTRODE SUBSAMPLES (POOLS) THE ACTIVITY OF A LARGE POPULATION OF NEURONS
span.quote: An often-assumed limitation of the LFP is that each electrode subsamples (pools) the activity of a large population of neurons.

span.label: The method degrades with neuronal variability: noisier populations yield fewer recoverable components.
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - the component count is partly a measure of the noise
span.quote: However, as the trial-by-trial variability of neuronal activity was increased, ICA identified a decreasing number of FFPs.

span.label: Recovered component width is bounded by the tuning width of the underlying population, so the readout cannot be sharper than what generates it.
span.note: what this limits: the spatial resolution of the readout: FOR NOISY POPULATIONS, FFP WIDTH INCREASED IN PROPORTION TO, BUT NEVER EXCEEDED, THE TUNING WIDTH OF THE UNDERLYING POPULATION'S PLACE FIELDS
span.quote: For noisy populations, FFP width increased in proportion to, but never exceeded, the tuning width of the underlying population’s place fields.

span.label: The mechanistic account of how FFPs relate to neuronal populations rests on a simulation, not on measurement.
span.note: what this limits: the mechanistic account linking components to populations: A SIMULATION WAS CONSTRUCTED IN WHICH THE LFP WAS MODELED AS THE SUPERIMPOSED ACTIVITY GENERATED BY NUMEROUS PLACE-MODULATED SYNAPTIC INPUTS
span.quote: To understand how properties of FFPs relate to the activity of the underlying neuronal population, a simulation was constructed in which the LFP was modeled as the superimposed activity generated by numerous place-modulated synaptic inputs ( fig. S9 ).

span.label: The carrier-wave and demodulation model: theta is treated as a carrier whose modulation carries the message, and the analysis strips the carrier phase to read that message out
span.quote: By analogy to radio communication, we defined the theta oscillation to be a carrier wave whose modulation contains information.

span.label: The compressed-sensing result that sparse signals can be recovered from mixed, subsampled measurements, used to justify recovering position from pooled field potentials by unsupervised learning
span.quote: Because position encoding is sparse, a theoretical result ( 14 ) based on compressed sensing ( 15 ) suggests that unsupervised learning can discover position-dependent sparse structure in the LFP without explicit knowledge of the rat’s position.

span.label: the carrier-and-modulation model of a signal, and the demodulation operation that recovers the message from it, applied to a brain rhythm
span.quote: By analogy to radio communication, we defined the theta oscillation to be a carrier wave whose modulation contains information.

span.label: the result that a sparse signal is recoverable from mixed and subsampled measurements, used to justify reading position out of pooled field potentials
span.quote: Because position encoding is sparse, a theoretical result ( 14 ) based on compressed sensing ( 15 ) suggests that unsupervised learning can discover position-dependent sparse structure in the LFP without explicit knowledge of the rat’s position.

span.quote: Building on earlier work [e.g., ( 25 )], these findings show how large-scale recordings of LFP can help in understanding the organization of activity in other brain regions, as well as developing robust decoders for brain-computer interfaces.

This information was extracted from the theta rhythm using a demodulation operation

The consequence is stated too: the field count is what makes the two populations separable, so the axis is also the reason the contrast matters. Q-463. · strength of the relation: 1

span.quote: Whitening and Bayesian decoding methods further improved accuracy, especially in the open field (120 by 120 or 180 by 180 cm 2 ) ( Fig. 2G ).

span.quote: We next asked whether the sparse structure of the broadband LFP (4 to 80 Hz) is also position dependent by training a convolutional sparse coding algorithm ( 18 ), which models signals as a sparse superposition of spatiotemporal features.

span.label: The spatiotemporal structure of the hippocampal theta rhythm, sampled across many electrodes, encodes the rat's position about as well as populations of spiking neurons do.
span.quote: Using high-density sampling of LFP and computational methods, we show that the spatiotemporal structure of the theta rhythm can encode position as robustly as neuronal spiking populations.

span.label: Decoding accuracy from field potentials matched that from spikes, with a slightly smaller median error, though the two decoders depended differently on running velocity and position.
span.quote: Although the cross-validated accuracy of the two decoders was comparable [optimal linear estimator (OLE) median error 6.7 ± 0.2 cm (LFP) and 9.2 ± 0.2 cm (spiking)] ( Fig. 2G and fig. S2 ), they had distinct velocity and position dependence ( Fig. 2, B and D ).

span.label: Successful decoding required both removing the theta carrier phase and keeping the signal's high dimensionality, even though most of its variance lay in a low-dimensional subspace.
span.quote: Accurate decoding of the theta rhythm depended on demodulation, as well as preserving the high dimensionality of the signal, even though the variance of the multielectrode signal was largely concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace

span.label: Unsupervised decomposition of the theta-band field potential recovered components that fire selectively at particular track positions and carry most of the signal variance.
span.quote: A subset of the components [termed feature-tuned field potentials (FFPs)] showed selective activation at specific positions along one direction of motion ( Fig. 3A and figs. S3 and S4 ) and comprised the major portion of the signal variance (53%, 69%, and 79% of total variance for n = 3 rats).

span.label: Each FFP's phase advanced progressively as the animal crossed its field, mirroring theta phase precession of place cell spikes.
span.quote: The phase of each demodulated FFP showed progressive advancement as the rat traversed the corresponding place field ( Fig. 4A ), reminiscent of the theta-phase precession of place cell spikes ( 19 ), and suggesting that the theta-rhythm arises largely from a population of phase-precessing neurons ( 10 ).

span.label: FFPs covered the track more evenly than pyramidal cell place fields did, which matched the relative accuracy of the two decoders.
span.quote: The distribution of the place fields of pyramidal cells was more irregular than that of the FFPs ( Fig. 4B and fig. S6 ), consistent with the performance of the corresponding decoders ( Fig. 2 ).

span.label: Position could still be decoded and FFPs still identified from dendritic-layer sites where no spikes were recorded, so the code is not an artefact of spike contamination.
span.quote: Accurate LFP decoding and identification of FFPs could also be performed on recording sites within the dendritic layers ( fig. S8 ), excluding somatic layers where spikes were detected.

span.label: A different, broadband sparse-coding analysis recovered position-tuned components spread along the whole track, matching the theta-band result.
span.quote: Despite differences in the analysis method and training data, the broadband components activated at single positions were spaced along the whole track, similar to the theta-band components ( Fig. 3D and fig. S5 ).

span.label: In simulation, raising trial-to-trial neuronal variability reduced the number of recoverable FFPs and widened them, but never beyond the tuning width of the underlying population.
span.quote: For noisy populations, FFP width increased in proportion to, but never exceeded, the tuning width of the underlying population’s place fields.
